title: rwgpu scene file
description: A level: ground, entities and the connections between their signals.

name.description: Display name. Default: the file name.

seed.description: Overrides the project seed for this scene.

camera.description: What part of the world is on screen.

center.description: Grid point [x, y] at the middle of the frame. Default: the middle of the ground.

offset.description: Extra shift in screen pixels [right, down]. Default: [0, 0].

view.description: How the world is projected. `iso`: the isometric view set by `[iso]`, where parallel lines stay parallel. `perspective`: a camera 30 degrees above the horizon, where far things are drawn smaller; `center` is drawn at the same size as in `iso`. Default: "iso".

turn.description: Degrees the camera is turned about the vertical line through `center`. At 0, +x runs down-right and +y down-left on screen; at 90, +x runs down-left and +y up-left. Default: 0.

zoom.description: Size factor: 2 draws everything in the world twice as large. Screen entities do not zoom. Default: 1.0.

ground.description: A rectangle of floor cells; also the bounds movers stay inside.

size.description: Number of cells [x, y]. Required unless `map` is given (then it is the map's size).

map.description: Rows of terrain characters, all the same length: row y, character x is cell [x, y]. Every character must be declared by a `[[terrain]]` `char`.

alt_color.description: Color of every other cell. Default: `color`, slightly darker.

items.description: A kind of ground for `[ground] map`: its character, look, and whether things can be built on it. Spawned entities (`action = "spawn"`) can only be placed where every cell of their footprint is buildable.

char.description: The single character that marks this terrain in `[ground] map`, e.g. "g" or "~".

name.description: Name used in messages and `inspect`, e.g. `water`. Default: the character.

alt_color.description: Color of every other cell (checkerboard). Default: `color`, slightly darker.

build.description: Spawned entities can be placed on it. false for water, rock, roads you must keep clear. Default: true.

terrain.description: Kinds of ground used by `[ground] map`, one `[[terrain]]` table each (grass, water, ...).

items.description: A thing in the world. Starts from an optional prefab; keys here override it (component tables merge key by key).

name.description: Unique name, needed to reference it from [[connect]], playtests and `inspect --entity`.

prefab.description: Prefab to start from: `wall` loads prefabs/wall.toml.

pos.description: Grid position [x, y] or [x, y, z]. +x is down-right on screen, +y is down-left, z is up. Default: [0, 0, 0].

cells.description: Place one copy on each listed cell instead of `pos`. Cannot be used with `name`.

footprint.description: Cells covered [along x, along y], from `pos` toward +x and +y: `[2, 2]` at pos [3, 4] covers [3, 4], [4, 4], [3, 5] and [4, 5]. Blocks and tiles fill the whole area; a sprite or label stands at its middle. It blocks, counts for triggers and is tapped on every covered cell. Only things that stay put can be bigger than one cell (no mover, patrol, wander, pushable or screen_pos). Default: [1, 1].

enabled.description: Disabled entities are not drawn, not solid, cannot be tapped and run no behaviors. Default: true.

solid.description: Nothing can move into its cell. Default: false.

pushable.description: A crate or weight. A mover that walks into it pushes it one cell, if the cell beyond is inside the ground and free (nothing solid, no actor, no other pushable); otherwise the mover is refused (`blocked`, reason `push`). Patrols and wanderers cannot push it: it blocks them like a solid. It holds pressure plates: triggers count it like an actor (`only` can name it). It cannot have mover, patrol or wander. Default: false.

tile.description: Flat diamond on the floor (marks, pressure plates).

color.description: Wall color; the top face too unless `top` is given. Default: "#9aa0a6".

top.description: Top face color (a roof, the water in a well). Default: `color`.

sprite.description: Upright shape standing on the cell (characters, items).

shape.description: circle (ellipse filling size), rect or diamond. Default: "circle".

size.description: Width and height in pixels. Default: [24, 32].

offset.description: Shift in pixels [right, down] from the standing point. Default: [0, 0].

mover.description: Moves one cell per direction input.

step_frames.description: Frames from one move to the next. `hold` for `step_frames × N` frames gives exactly N steps. Default: 8.

patrol.description: Walks a fixed path of cells.

mode.description: loop: back to the first cell; pingpong: walk the path backwards. Default: "loop".

area.description: Two corner cells [[x0, y0], [x1, y1]] to stay inside. Default: the whole ground.

trigger.description: Emits signals when actors step on or off its cell.

on_enter.description: Signal emitted when the cell becomes occupied. Default: "pressed".

on_exit.description: Signal emitted when the cell becomes empty. Default: "released".

only.description: Only this entity (by name) counts. Default: any actor.

label.description: Text drawn with the built-in pixel font (scores, names).

scale.description: Pixel size of the font: 2 doubles it. Default: 1.

screen_pos.description: Draw this entity on the screen instead of in the world (a HUD): `[x, y]` is the top-left pixel of its sprite and label. Screen entities are drawn above the world, ignore the camera, can be tapped, and can only have `sprite` and `label`.

props.description: Game data: numbers, text and flags, e.g. `{ score = 0 }`. A prop's type is fixed by its starting value. `[[connect]]` `add`/`set` change props at runtime, `when` conditions and label `{placeholders}` read them, `inspect` shows them and `[[expect]] props` checks them.

counts.description: Props that count enabled copies of a prefab, kept up to date by the engine: `counts = { houses = "house" }` makes `houses` an integer prop equal to the number of enabled `house` entities (placed in the scene or spawned; an entity with `prefab = "house"` is a copy whatever keys it overrides). It changes when a copy is spawned, disabled or enabled again; the entity then emits `changed`, so labels, `when` conditions and `[[expect]] props` read it like any prop. `add`/`set` cannot change it.

allow.description: Warning codes that are intended for this entity and should not be reported, e.g. `["W0201"]` for deliberately stacked solids. Errors cannot be allowed.

items.description: One solid of an entity's shape list: a `kind` that fills the box from `at` to `at + size`, in one flat color, shaded by the scene's light like a block. `at` is counted in cells from the entity's own corner (the lowest x and y of its footprint, at its height): `at = [0, 0, 1.5]`, `size = [2, 2, 0.8]` is a roof on a 2 x 2 house 1.5 high. Shapes are drawn in list order and stay inside the footprint (W0208). Two shapes must not have upright sides in one plane that overlap (W0209).

kind.description: `box`; `roof`: a gable roof, its ridge along x; `wedge`: a ramp or lean-to roof that rises toward +x; `cylinder` and `cone`: round, upright.

at.description: The corner of its box with the lowest x, y and z. Default: [0, 0, 0].

size.description: The size of its box along x, y and z, in cells.

turn.description: Quarter turns of the solid inside its box, from +x toward +y: at 90 a roof's ridge runs along y and a wedge rises toward +y, at 180 toward -x. Default: 0.

shape.description: What it is built of: solids with flat colors, one `[[shape]]` table each (in a scene: `[[entity.shape]]`, or `shape = [{ ... }]`). A list here replaces the prefab's.

entity.description: Things in the world, one `[[entity]]` table each.

items.description: When `from` emits `signal`, apply `action` to `to` (or each of `actions`, in order), if every `when` condition holds. Every entity emits `tapped` when tapped; triggers emit `on_enter`/`on_exit`; an entity whose prop is changed by `add`/`set` (or whose `counts` change) emits `changed`; a spawned entity emits `spawned`; when a `spawn` cannot be placed, the source of its signal emits `refused`. `from = "ground"` listens to taps on ground cells that hit no entity (and to their refused spawns); `from_prefab` listens to every entity made from a prefab, and `to = "self"` then targets the one that emitted.

from.description: Name of the emitting entity, or `ground` for taps on empty ground cells (signals `tapped`, and `refused` when a spawn it started cannot be placed). Use exactly one of `from` and `from_prefab`.

from_prefab.description: Listen to every entity made from this prefab, placed in the scene (whatever keys it overrides) or spawned later: `from_prefab = "coin"` instead of one [[connect]] per coin.

to.description: Name of the target entity, or `self` for the entity that emitted (with `from_prefab`). Required for every action except `spawn`.

action.description: enable, disable or toggle the target; `add` a number to / `set` one of its props; or `spawn` a new copy of `prefab` where the signal happened. Use exactly one of `action` and `actions`.

prop.description: With `add`/`set`: the target's prop (declared in its `props`).

value.description: With `add`: the number to add (default 1; negative subtracts). With `set`: the new value (required), of the prop's type.

prefab.description: With `spawn`: the prefab to place. It goes on the tapped cell (`from = "ground"`) or the emitter's cell, with its `footprint` toward +x and +y, if every covered cell is inside the ground, on terrain with `build = true` and free: no enabled entity that is drawn there, solid, an actor or a trigger (data-only entities with just props take up no space). Otherwise nothing is placed (`blocked`, reason `edge`, `terrain` or `occupied`) and the source of the signal (the ground, for ground taps) emits `refused` on that cell, if a [[connect]] listens.

cost.description: With `spawn`: the price, paid from a prop only if the copy is placed: `cost = { entity = "town", prop = "coins", amount = 3 }`. If the prop is below `amount`, nothing is placed or paid (`blocked`, reason `funds`, checked before the cell) and the signal's source emits `refused` with reason `funds`.

entity.description: The entity that pays, by name (a HUD or a hidden data entity).

prop.description: Its number prop to pay from (not a `counts` prop).

amount.description: How much a copy costs (more than 0; an integer for an integer prop).

items.description: One item of a `[[connect]]` `when` list, checked against the current state when the signal arrives. Names an `entity` and exactly one of `occupied`, `enabled` or `prop`: `{ entity = "plate_b", occupied = true }`, `{ entity = "gate", enabled = false }`, `{ entity = "hud", prop = "coins", at_least = 3 }` (a `counts` prop counts copies: `{ entity = "job", prop = "houses", at_least = 2 }`). On `signal = "refused"` only, `{ reason = "terrain" }` (no entity) picks one reason.

entity.description: The entity to look at, by name. Required, except in a `reason` condition.

occupied.description: true: an enabled actor or pushable is on the entity's cell right now (for a trigger: one its `only` accepts). false: nothing is.

prop.description: One of the entity's props, compared with `equals`, `at_least` and/or `at_most`.

equals.description: With `prop`: the prop has exactly this value.

at_least.description: With `prop`: the number prop is ≥ this.

at_most.description: With `prop`: the number prop is ≤ this.

reason.description: Only with `signal = "refused"`, and alone: the spawn was refused for this reason (outside the ground, terrain with `build = false`, a taken cell, or too little to pay its `cost`).

when.description: Conditions that must all hold when the signal arrives, or the action is skipped (logged as `skipped`). They are checked once, before the first action. For OR, write one `[[connect]]` per alternative. Item keys: `rwgpu explain condition`.

items.description: One item of a `[[connect]]` `actions` list: the same keys as a single-action [[connect]]. Items run in order after the connection's `when` held (checked once, before the first). A `spawn` that cannot be placed stops the rest of the list (logged as `skipped`), so `[{ action = "spawn", prefab = "house" }, { action = "add", to = "town", prop = "coins", value = -3 }]` pays only for a house that was placed.

action.description: enable, disable or toggle the target; `add` a number to / `set` one of its props; or `spawn` a new copy of `prefab` where the signal happened.

to.description: Name of the target entity, or `self` for the entity that emitted (with `from_prefab`). Required for every action except `spawn`.

prop.description: With `add`/`set`: the target's prop (declared in its `props`).

value.description: With `add`: the number to add (default 1; negative subtracts). With `set`: the new value (required), of the prop's type.

prefab.description: With `spawn`: the prefab to place. It goes on the tapped cell (`from = "ground"`) or the emitter's cell, with its `footprint` toward +x and +y, if every covered cell is inside the ground, on terrain with `build = true` and free: no enabled entity that is drawn there, solid, an actor or a trigger (data-only entities with just props take up no space). Otherwise nothing is placed (`blocked`, reason `edge`, `terrain` or `occupied`) and the source of the signal (the ground, for ground taps) emits `refused` on that cell, if a [[connect]] listens.

cost.description: With `spawn`: the price, paid from a prop only if the copy is placed: `cost = { entity = "town", prop = "coins", amount = 3 }`. If the prop is below `amount`, nothing is placed or paid (`blocked`, reason `funds`, checked before the cell) and the signal's source emits `refused` with reason `funds`.

entity.description: The entity that pays, by name (a HUD or a hidden data entity).

prop.description: Its number prop to pay from (not a `counts` prop).

amount.description: How much a copy costs (more than 0; an integer for an integer prop).

actions.description: Several actions for the same signal and `when`, run in order: `actions = [{ action = "set", to = "town", prop = "tool", value = "tree" }, { action = "set", to = "hint", prop = "msg", value = "" }]`. Each item has the keys `action`, `to`, `prop`, `value`, `prefab` and `cost` (`rwgpu explain action`), which then cannot be on the [[connect]] itself. If a `spawn` in the list cannot be placed, the actions after it do not run.
